title: Prime Books Primary Standard, Years 1 to 4
status: locked-candidate, awaiting the teacher's sign-off on the items in open_items

scope.collection: Standard A (Primary). Standard B, Years 7 to 12, is not touched by this lock.
scope.contents_component_reference: y01 Physical Education master contents page (bar plus one card per unit)
scope.print_route: BookVault, perfect-bound paperback. No other printer is planned, so printing constrains the page.

geometry.unit: millimetres are the source of truth, points are derived at 72/25.4
geometry.margin_note: mirrored margins: the inner margin is deeper than the outer one, because BookVault binds on the inner edge

extent.rule: interior page count is 11, 23, 35, 47, 59, 71, 83, 95 or 107: one less than a multiple of 12
extent.applies_to: the interior file, after the front and back covers are stripped for the cover wrap
extent.reserves_last_page: BookVault prints its production barcode on the last interior page: keep that page clear in its lower area

year_ladder.basis: adopted defaults for Years 1 to 4, to be verified against the Year 1 reference

unit_palette.rule: unit n takes rung n in every book of the series, so the same unit number is the same colour in every subject

page_map.note: no folio, full-bleed art, year stripe on the spine edge
publisher identity, year, tagline, INSIDE THIS BOOK, IMPRINT rows, AI disclosure when generated art is used
colour bar with one segment per unit, then one card per unit
invitation plus the cast of characters
labels, icons and meanings, defined once
each unit: opener, get started, concept and model, your turn, extension, applied project, reflection, word bank
demonstrate the learning, not an exhibition
two columns of cards: image, headword, short definition
real URLs and licences, hanging indents
kept clear for BookVault's printed barcode
printed again in the cover wrap, so it is stripped from the interior file

contents_component.form: one colour bar segment per unit, then one tinted card per unit
contents_component.segment_count: equals the number of units, never fixed at six
card_rows: Unit n, How did it go?
contents_component.page_numbers: generated from the built PDF and verified against the real page index

illustration.direction: original Beatrix Potter style: fine ink contours, transparent watercolour, warm muted pigments, lightly textured cream paper
illustration.cast: same characters and clothing throughout a book

grade.1-2: large actions, short sequences, direct naming, generous response space
grade.3-4: more process detail, comparisons, labelled evidence, less decorative cast

print.colour: CMYK converted once through one FOGRA profile; body and heading black is 100 percent K, never a rich black
print.transparency: flattened, so cast portraits are composited rather than left on alpha
print.images: 300 dpi target, 150 dpi absolute floor, native pixels recorded
print.cover_wrap_formula: 2 x trim width + spine + 3 mm + 3 mm, by trim height + 3 mm + 3 mm
print.spine: from BookVault's sizing calculator for the actual stock, rounded up to a whole millimetre; spine text only when the spine is 6 mm or wider, centred and K only

open_items: the teacher's eye on palette rungs 5 and 6
the real spine width from BookVault's sizing calculator for the stock actually ordered
whether existing 612 x 792 pt masters migrate to 216 x 279 mm, or keep printing as a declared custom size
the page budget per year (59, 71, 83, 95 are proposals)
the handwriting ruling and words-per-page ladder, once the Year 1 reference is re-measured
